info.title: Quack
info.description: The API of Quack's dashboard. Same-origin only: sign in with Discord (session cookie); every POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE also sends `X-CSRF-Token` (from `GET /api/auth/me`) and, under `/api/guilds` and `/api/me`, an `Idempotency-Key`. Errors use one envelope, `{ "error": ErrorBody }`.

get.summary: Discord's redirect back after sign-in.
Starts Discord sign-in.

parameters.name: redirect_to
parameters.description:
Where to land after signing in: a path on this dashboard (anything
else lands on `/guilds`).

post.summary: Signs out: deletes the session and clears its cookie.

post.summary:
Removes an evidence item added by mistake: hidden from Discord and the
member, listed collapsed for staff, never deleted.

The server activity log module. Its counters are in-process and reset

The tickets module.

Turns a module on (`409 module_not_ready` lists what to fix).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start (RFC 3339, inclusive); default one calendar month before `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End (RFC 3339, exclusive); default now. 1 s to 366 days after `from`.

get.summary: The server's tickets, newest first.

Only tickets in these states, comma-separated (`opening,open,closing`);

Replies to staff's request for more information.

Action.description: An action as staff see it.

version.description: The settings' version: send it back as `expected_version`.

ActivityLogModule.description:
The server activity log module (route 43). Counters are in-process
and reset when Quack restarts.

ActivityLogSettings.description: Server activity log settings (part of route 43).

routes.description: The channel each event type posts to (absent: not logged).

ActivityLogSettingsUpdate.description: Route 44's body: the settings and the version they were read at.

expected_version.description:
The `version` the page was read at; a newer one is refused with
`settings_changed`.

routes.description: The channel each event type posts to (absent: not logged).

context.description: Field key → answer. Numbers may be JSON numbers or strings.

evidence_links.description: Message links to save as evidence.

member_id.description: The member the case is about.

replaces_case_number.description: The voided case this one replaces.

rule_version.description: The version the preview showed; another is `409 rule_changed`.

note.description: A staff note (0–500 characters) for each item this adds.

text.description: The reply staff asked for (1–4,000 characters).

Appeal.description: An appeal with its timeline and case.

AppealEvent.description: One event on an appeal's timeline.

closed_by_void.description: Quack closed it because the case was voided.

version.description: Send back as `expected_version` with a decision.

key.description: The bucket's stable key (a date, rule ID, or enum value).

oneOf.description: What Quack v4 recorded, for an imported case.

timeline.description: Moderation log entries about the case, oldest first.

Case.description: A case as staff see it.

CaseGuild.description: The server a member's case is in.

CaseLogEntry.description: One moderation log entry about the case.

CasePreview.description: What applying a rule would choose now (route 58).

rule_version.description: Send back as `rule_version` when adding the case.

dm_state.description: The case DM's state; `not_needed` when the level sends none.

rule_name.description: The rule's name in the case's version ("Imported" without one).

CaseVoided.description:
Route 23's answer: the voided case and what the void did, in the
sentence the bot answers with (`case.void_done`).

message.description: What the void did, as a sentence.

problems.description: Each problem's code and how to fix it.

setting.description:
The setting's API name: `log_channel_id`, `appeal_channel_id`,
`evidence_channel_id`, or a module's (`tickets.queue_channel_id`,
`tickets.entry_channel_id`, `activity_log.routes`,
`honeypot.channel_id`).

staff_only.description:
Whether it must be staff-only; the ticket entry and honeypot
channels are for members, so only Quack's access is checked.

ChannelKind.description: A channel kind the dashboard shows.

ChannelProblem.description: One reason a channel isn't a usable staff channel.

fence.description: This process holds the singleton lock.

migrations.description: The applied migrations equal the binary's.

workers.description: Every job dispatcher ran a pass in the last 15 s.

value.description: The answer as text; message links show as a placeholder.

expected_version.description: The version the reader saw; another is `409 appeal_changed`.

reason.description: Why (1–2,000 characters); the member reads it.

position.description: The channel's place in Discord's list.

DirectoryMember.description: A member or account, for display.

display_name.description: Nickname, else global name, else username.

in_server.description: Whether they are in the server now.

color.description: The role's color (0 when Quack doesn't know it).

Dm.description: The case DM; null on the case when the level sends none.

expected_context_revision.description: The revision the editor loaded; another is `409 context_changed`.

expected_version.description: The version the editor loaded; another is `409 rule_changed`.

EligibleRule.description: A rule the honeypot may use.

levels.description:
Its levels, for the warning's default wording (anyone who can read
the honeypot settings sees them, without reading rules).

Embed.description: An embed of a saved message.

EntryLinks.description: Dashboard paths for an entry's typed links.

ErrorBody.description: The body of an error response.

message.description: What happened and what to do, from `quack-text`.

trace_id.description: The request's 32-hex trace ID, or null when it has no trace.

Evidence.description:
One evidence item as staff see it (§14.3): a saved message or uploaded
files, with its note, whether the member sees it, the messages around
it, and who removed it.

oneOf.description: The message's channel; null for uploaded files.
The message; null for uploaded files.

note.description: The staff note (never shown to the member).

note_revision.description: Send back as `expected_note_revision` when editing the note.

oneOf.description: Set once staff removed it; shown collapsed.

surrounding.description:
Messages around a staff-added message, oldest first; null when none
were saved.

url.description: The message's link; null for uploaded files.

visible_to_member.description:
Whether the member sees it on their case page: always for a saved
message; uploaded files only once staff show them.

EvidenceAdded.description:
Routes 25 and 60's answer: the case and what adding the evidence did,
in the sentence the bot answers with (`evidence.added`).

already_saved.description: Messages that were already saved (or being saved) for the case.

case.description: The case after the evidence was added.

files.description:
Files Quack is copying to the evidence channel (one uploaded-files
item).

message.description: What adding the evidence did, as a sentence.

retrying.description: Messages whose earlier save failed, being saved again.

EvidenceEdited.description:
Routes 61–63's answer: the case after the edit and what it did, in the
sentence the bot answers with (`evidence.note.*`,
`evidence.visibility.*`, `evidence.removed`).

message.description: What the edit did, as a sentence.

EvidenceFile.description: One file of an evidence item.

EvidenceRemoved.description: Who removed an evidence item, and when (§7.5).

kind.description: What kind of answer it takes.

label.description: The question and the member's label, 1–100 characters.

FieldError.description: One field problem of a `validation_failed` (or `member_refused`) error.

code.description: The problem's machine code (§3.3, §4.6, §13.1, or a refusal).

field.description: The JSON path of the field, such as `levels[1].from_case_count`.

message.description: What to fix, in the reader's words.

GuildCounts.description: Exact counts for the staff layout.

can_install.description: Not installed, and the account has Manage Server there.

mfa_blocked.description:
The account would have a staff capability but Quack has no record
of its 2FA.

channels.description:
Each configured channel: the core staff channels, then the channels
of the modules that are on.

missing_permissions.description: Server permissions Quack needs and lacks.

version.description: The settings' version: send it back as `expected_version`.

rule_id.description: The rule applied to members who post there.

warning_text.description: The warning posted in the channel (up to 1,500 characters).

HoneypotSettingsUpdate.description: Route 46's body: the settings and the version they were read at.

expected_version.description:
The `version` the page was read at; a newer one is refused with
`settings_changed`.

rule_id.description: The rule applied to members who post there.

warning_text.description: The warning posted in the channel (up to 1,500 characters).

confirm.description: Must be `true`: the reader confirmed the import.

name.description: A different name for the imported rule.

ImportedCase.description: What Quack v4 recorded about an imported case (`cases.imported`).

oneOf.description: The level's action; null makes the case a warning.

from_case_count.description: The case count at which this level starts.

send_dm.description: Whether the member gets a case DM.

oneOf.description: Remove the member from the server.

delete_message_seconds.description: Seconds of recent messages Discord deletes (0–604,800).

expires_at.description: When it ends; sign in again after.

can_reply.description: Whether the member may reply now.

version.description: Send back as `expected_version` with a reply.

MemberAppealEvent.description: One appeal event, never naming staff.

closed_by_void.description: Quack closed the appeal because its case was voided.

replaces_case_number.description: Only when both cases are about this member.

MemberCaseSummary.description: One of the member's own cases.

action_text.description: What happened, in the member's words.

can_appeal.description: Whether the member may appeal now.

MemberEvidence.description: One saved message: text, embed types and titles, file names.

MemberFile.description: One file, served by the member file route.

MemberSummary.description: A member's cases in the server, counted.

ModuleState.description: Whether a module is on, why Quack turned it off, and what blocks it.

problems.description: What blocks turning it on (empty when nothing is known to).

ModulesState.description: Each module's state, by JSON module name.

Problem.description: One reason a module can't be turned on (`module_not_ready`).

Purpose.description: Whether an action is a case's original or the undo of one.

Rule.description: A rule with its current definition and history.

RuleCount.description: A member's cases under one rule.

rule_id.description: Null for imported cases without a rule.

appealable.description: Whether cases under this version can be appealed.

counting_window_days.description: Count only cases from the last N days (1–36,500); null counts all.

fields.description: Case context fields, in display order (at most 10).

name.description: 1–100 characters; unique among the server's active rules.

reason.description: The official reason shown to the member, 1–1,000 characters.

counting_window_days.description: Only cases from the last this many days count (null: all).

expected_note_revision.description: The `note_revision` the editor loaded; another is `409 note_changed`.

note.description: The note (0–500 characters); null or blank clears it.

visible_to_member.description: Whether the member sees these uploaded files on their case page.

version.description: Send back as `expected_version` when changing role lists.

SettingsChange.description:
Route 37's body: only the fields sent change. A channel sent as null
is cleared; text sent empty is cleared.

expected_version.description: Required with a role list: the `version` the editor loaded.

statement.description: Why the case should be reconsidered (1–4,000 characters).

SurroundingMessage.description: One message saved around a staff-added message (text only, §7.2).

before.description: Sent before the saved message (else after).

files.description: How many files it had (never copied).

Ticket.description:
A ticket. The ticket's member gets it without `closed_by` and with
`closed_by_you` instead.

number.description: Its number in the server, from 1; its thread is `ticket-0042`.

oneOf.description: The staff channel new tickets are announced in.

TicketSettingsUpdate.description: Route 42's body: the settings and the version they were read at.

expected_version.description:
The `version` the page was read at; a newer one is refused with
`settings_changed`.

oneOf.description: The staff channel new tickets are announced in.

version.description: The settings' version: send it back as `expected_version`.

TimelineText.description: One item of the member timeline.

VersionEntry.description: One version in a rule's history.

reconstructed.description: Rebuilt by the importer from old cases.

csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrf.description: The session's CSRF token, required on every mutation.

session.name: __Host-quack_session
session.description: The session cookie (`quack_session` on a loopback http dashboard).
